findings.F1: The test ran on a single coin and window (BTCUSD w1, 2022, 120 daily bars, 23 non-overlapping 5-bar grid cases). ETH and BNB are absent from the record, so only 3 extreme cases (forecast ≤ −10) were found, against the plan's minimum of 30.
findings.F2: The extreme situation is not rare. 15 of 120 bars (12.5%) have forecast ≤ −10 and 3 of 23 grid cases (13%) do, so a coin-window of about 120 daily bars yields roughly 3 extreme cases. Reaching 30 needs about 10 such coin-windows, or about 230 grid cases.
findings.F3: The extreme bars come in clusters. There are 3 runs of forecast ≤ −10, with lengths of 1, 2 and 12 bars (mean 5). The 5-bar grid therefore samples a long run only every fifth bar, which keeps the case count small relative to the bars spent at an extreme.
findings.F4: The config's forecast is short-only and spread unevenly. 81 of 120 bars are exactly 0, 39 are negative, and the 5% and 10% quantiles are −20 and −13.2. The standardised raw value ranges from −8.0 to +11.9, so the −20 cap is reached often once RSI is high.
findings.F5: The outcome varies widely from case to case. The standard deviation of the 5-bar forward return on the grid is 0.076, against a mean excess after extremes of −0.068 (t −1.84 on 3 cases). The direction cannot be judged on this count, but 30 cases would give a standard error near 0.014.
findings.F6: The available Kraken data can supply the count. The six default coins (BTC, ETH, LTC, XMR, XRP, ZEC) run in all four folds A–D, and at about 3 extreme cases per coin-window this gives well over the 30 the plan requires. BNB is not available.

ideas.idea: When a coin's 14-day RSI sits above its neutral level, the coin's return over the next 5 days is lower than its usual 5-day return. The higher the RSI, the larger the shortfall.
ideas.consequence: If confirmed, a trader would lean short or reduce long exposure as a coin's 14-day RSI climbs to its extremes; if rejected, a trader would refuse to fade high RSI readings.
ideas.name: high RSI predicts pullback
ideas.data: instruments: BTC, ETH, LTC, XMR, XRP, ZEC; bar: 1d; period: folds A, B, C and D
